title: 第7章 性感美艳的女医生
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
李大壮说的头头是道，张桂芬虽然不信儿子真能把老伴手指接上，但却点相信他可能真不傻了！

    傻子说话可不会这么利索！

    “爸妈，大壮确实不傻了！”李秋霜用力的对爸妈点点头。

    李家二老这才彻底信了，巨大的惊喜充斥着二老的心灵，张桂芬激动的拍着儿子结实的臂膀，泪水再次模糊了双眼：

    “好好好！大壮你可算是好了！老天爷终于开了回眼啊！”

    李守义也颤抖着说：“我……我这手更不用……治了，大壮好了，攒钱给……给他娶媳妇！”

    李大壮看着身形佝偻苍老的父母，心中酸涩无比，眼眶也有些湿润：“爸妈，别的咱们回家再说，但现在，我得赶紧给我爸把手指接上！”

    “请问你们这儿有针灸用的银针吗？能借我用一下吗？”李大壮对诊室里的医生护士问道。

    “病人家属，你们确定你家这位男士真的不傻了吗？以我从医多年的经验来看，他可不只是傻，还傻的挺严重呢！”

    一位上了年纪的男医生不客气的说：“你们自己听听他刚才说的话，还用针灸接骨连肉，简直就是笑话，他要真有这本事，我副院长的位置给他坐！”

    几个长相风骚的小护士，也都面露嘲笑，一副看傻子的表情看着李大壮，只有一个性感美艳，婀娜多姿的漂亮女医生，一脸焦急的说：“各位，现在不是赌气的时候，赶紧把病人送去县医院才是正事！”

    “断指再接上的最佳黄金时间只有六到八小时，现在已经过去两小时了，你们到县城还需要至少半个小时，每一分钟都很紧急！”

    “谢谢你的提醒，不过我真的不是在说傻话，如果你能帮我拿副银针来，等我帮我爸的手指接上，可以免费帮你治疗大小胸的问题！”

    李大壮一眼就看出来，这位漂亮的女医生，胸一个大一个小，虽然她用硅胶垫，把小的那个垫高了，但拥有媚儿传承的李大壮，眼力可不一般！

    女医生精致美艳的脸蛋瞬间通红，看似丰满圆润的前胸，因为急切的喘息上下起伏，红唇惊的微微张开，美眸全是难以置信！

    她激动的脱口而出：“我明明在内衣里放了乳胶垫，别人都没发现，你个傻子是怎么看出来的！？”

    诊室众人，纷纷惊讶的张大了嘴巴，那个傻子说的竟然是真的！
content_en:
At this time, Zhou Xianglan was leaning in front of the canteen counter charmingly, waving a fan. When she saw the anxious Li Dazhuang from a distance, she started teasing him with a smile.

    It's a pity that Li Dazhuang is really anxious now and is not in the mood to appreciate her coquettishness: "Sister Xianglan! Lend me your motorcycle tricycle quickly. Something happened to my dad and I have to go to town quickly!"

    "What nonsense are you talking about, you silly boy? Your dad was fine when he left in the morning, what could happen? If you have nothing to do, go to the house with your sister and play a game with her to pass the time, okay?"

    Zhou Xianglan was originally married to Xinghua Village, but her husband found a mistress outside and stayed away from home all year round. He divorced her two years ago. She has been running a canteen in the village since she got married. After the divorce, she had nowhere to go. It happened that her ex-husband did not return to his hometown, so she continued to work here.

    However, a divorced woman is always lonely, especially recently. When the weather gets hot, her plump body and her loving heart become restless. She cannot sleep at all unless she moves her hands every night.

    At this moment, she looked at Li Dazhuang, who was tall and handsome, with steam all over his body. The emptiness and loneliness came out again, and she could hardly stand the fever in broad daylight. Fragrant sweat dripped down, and his charming eyes seemed to have given birth to transparent sticky threads, which stuck to Li Dazhuang's body!

    "Da Zhuang, sister is serious. There is White Rabbit toffee in my sister's house. If you follow me into the house, I will give it to you..."

    Zhou Xianglan couldn't bear it anymore. Even if Li Dazhuang was a fool, he was more attractive than other men she had ever seen. She couldn't wait to take Li Dazhuang's hand and drag him into the inner room!

    Li Dazhuang was so anxious that his head was on fire: "Sister Xianglan! Now is not the time! Something really happened to my dad. I have to go to town quickly. You can lend me a motorcycle tricycle and I will return it to you when I come back in the evening. I can eat whatever you want me to eat!"

    "You can really eat anything?" Zhou Xianglan couldn't help but fantasize about certain scenes, and her whole body suddenly became weak. She couldn't help but lean against Dazhuang's broad chest. Her plump body was trembling slightly with excitement. The snow-white roundness stimulated Li Dazhuang's chest!

    Li Dazhuang said anxiously: "Sister Xianglan, as long as you quickly give me the key to the tricycle, I can really eat anything!"

    Zhou Xianglan suddenly laughed, her tone ambiguous and pointed: "You silly boy, although your brain is not bright, you have a mouth that is quite rare. You can talk and eat..."

    Li Dazhuang was speechless: "Sister Xianglan, my brain is indeed fine, but I think your brain seems to be ruined!"

    "If you don't take me down, I'll go to someone else's house!" Li Dazhuang really didn't have time to make such nonsense with Zhou Xianglan, so he turned around and left.

    Only then did Zhou Xianglan realize that something was wrong. Li Dazhuang's anxious expression and eyes seemed to be no different from those of a normal person. Could it be that he was really not stupid anymore?
title_en: Chapter 6 I’ll give you White Rabbit toffee
